name: ringwatch-windows
description: Windows desktop hub for Ring cameras, live video streaming, local & cloud recordings, sensor events, and AI package detection.
author: RingWatch

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron .
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
